name: Multi-Functional Travel Backpack | Business Daypack with Laptop Compartment | Black & Red
description:
Stay organized on the go with the Multi-Functional Travel Backpack, designed for work, school, and travel. Made with durable, water-resistant polyester and reinforced stitching, it offers multiple compartments including a secure laptop section. Padded straps and breathable back support provide lasting comfort, while its sleek design makes it ideal for professionals, students, and travelers. Includes a rain cover for added protection.

Key Features:
Spacious capacity with multiple compartments
Durable & water-resistant polyester with reinforced stitching
Padded shoulder straps & breathable back support for comfort
Sleek, professional design for office, college & travel use
Protective rain cover included

How to Use:
Place laptop in dedicated padded compartment
Organize accessories, books & documents in pockets
Adjust padded straps for a comfortable fit
Use included rain cover during wet weather

Material:
Water-Resistant Polyester Fabric, Reinforced Zippers

Safety Information:
Avoid overloading to prevent zipper strain
Keep away from sharp objects to protect fabric
Clean with a damp cloth; avoid bleach
Store in a cool, dry place when not in use

Package Includes:
1 × Multi-Functional Travel Backpack (Black & Red)
1 × Protective Rain Cover
